title: Payments Feature — Epic
description:
Epic tracking the full Payments feature for Nexora's Enterprise SaaS platform. Enables direct billing via Stripe payment gateway. Required for Enterprise tier upsell ($2.1M ARR impact per Q4 All Hands).

Delay reason: PCI-DSS Level 1 compliance gaps discovered (see NEX-217) and API rate limiting conflict with Stripe webhooks (see NEX-231). Full context in email_03 and standup_03 meeting notes.
